mapper.sql: id, user_id, ai_generation_id, plan_id, model_name, image_count, image_paths, recognized_json, status, error_message, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_import (user_id, ai_generation_id, plan_id, model_name, image_count, image_paths, recognized_json, status, error_message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{aiGenerationId}, #{planId}, #{modelName}, #{imageCount}, #{imagePaths}, #{recognizedJson}, #{status}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE image_import SET status = 'RECOGNIZED', model_name = #{modelName}, recognized_json = #{recognizedJson}, ai_generation_id = #{aiGenerationId}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
